name: Nagahama Masayoshi
source:
A Meiji-era detective who upholds law, order, and honor as absolute ideals. He embodies the spirit of both the traditional samurai and the forward-looking Meiji era. Though his strict bearing suggests severity, beneath it lies a kind heart and a deep empathy for those he serves. 

[From [url=https://duskindexgion.bushiroadgames.com/en/#character]Official English website[/url]]
